rationale: Batch the standalone right-join normalization stage using an owning postorder snapshot and explicit strict locality contract. Remove unused parent recomputation.
limits: Only zero-property stages whose every rule opts into pure edge replacement. All other stages retain conservative restart/invalidation. Trace serialization costs are unchanged. Does not close optimizer-wide incremental invalidation work.
validation: Generated graph equivalence to restart scheduler, including shared Replicate producers, subplans, nested/unmatched joins, count ceiling; exact output binding and type/parent checks; native existing join suite; actual visits/property-computation counters.

independent_source_review.notes: Owning snapshots keep nodes/parents alive, and right-join replacement satisfies the opt-in restrictions. Added a final fresh conservative pass because traversal deduplicates nodes rather than independent owning slots. Replicate shared slots remain supported. Requires native and scheduler-cost checks.
